name: Panceta Levels List
description: Browse the Panceta Levels List (PLL) and GPLL in-game.

pll-api-base.name: PLL API URL
pll-api-base.description: Base API URL of the PLL website (the mod reads /levels and /levels/{id} from it).

gpll-api-base.name: GPLL API URL
gpll-api-base.description: Base API URL of the GPLL website (same format as PLL). Leave empty until the GPLL exists.

refresh-interval.name: Live refresh (seconds)
refresh-interval.description: How often the open list refreshes itself from the website. 0 = only when you press refresh.

show-upll.name: Show UPLL-only levels
show-upll.description: Also show levels that are only on the UPLL (above the PLL skill cap).
